newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates end up on OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates end up on OMO.

text.p: Pakistani money rates closed higher on Thursday after a special open market operation (OMO) by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were initially offered at 18 percent but rates soon rose and closing deals were seen in the range of 19 to 20 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Dealers said the market was likely to open at high levels after the Friday weekend as it closed short and some banks were seen approaching the central bank's discount window.
